legacy_block_law: FIELDS[:64] is field-for-field the frozen v1 table (legacy_v1_table.py, 1b6d7749); a v1 consumer (64-dim norm arrays) receives a v1-width projection and mask

declared_orders.command_index_law: index = leg_index*4 + channel_index (leg l=0, r=1; channels phase_off, stride_amp, lift_amp, stiff)

pad_pair_orderings.heel_mp: pair [a, b] = [g_heel, g_mp] -- endpoint identity measured
pad_pair_orderings.lohi: pair [g_lo, g_hi] reconstructed -- endpoint identity NOT in the record; endpoint-signed fields declared unavailable

normalization_source.recipe: mean/std over the available ticks of the lane record set; never-available -> 0/1; std floored at 1e-3 (the P3 normalization law)

availability_recipe: unavailable group -> mean-fill, availability mask observed via mask_mean/mask_frac_avail
